name: gi-individual-income-tax
description: Prepare an ordinary individual income-tax comparison for the year 1 July 2026 to 30 June 2027. Includes pre-death income obligations and specified allowance reductions under section 47. Includes specified approved/imported pension rules; Category 2, HEPSS, other pension cases, frontier-worker treaty residence and special deductions require separate review. This source-cited draft supports preparation of reviewable working papers using the stated periods, evidence requirements and computation examples. Retain source evidence and effective dates; unresolved points and professional review remain explicit. Use the linked official materials when checking a case, and obtain a qualified local review before filing or making a payment. Read the explicit exclusions before applying its calculations to different facts.
